ios.desc:
Talk. DayTape handles the rest.

Record a voice note and DayTape instantly transcribes it, pulls out your action items, and summarizes what you said — all on your device, completely private.

No typing. No organizing. Just talk about your day and let on-device AI turn your thoughts into a clear list of what to do next.

CAPTURE YOUR THOUGHTS
Hit record and talk. DayTape transcribes your voice note and extracts the important stuff automatically.

GET AI-POWERED TAKEAWAYS
Every entry gets broken down into individual action items you can schedule, check off, or save for later.

SEE YOUR WEEKLY RECAP
DayTape surfaces patterns across your entries so you can see what keeps coming up and what you've followed through on.

100% PRIVATE, ON-DEVICE AI
Your recordings, transcripts, and summaries never leave your phone. No cloud. No accounts. No data collection.

PAY ONCE, YOURS FOREVER. One-time purchase unlocks everything. No subscriptions. Try 3 entries free.

Terms of Use: https://daytape.ai/terms.html

quotes.text: Built this for myself. I never listen back to voice memos but I keep recording them. DayTape transcribes and finds patterns across entries. iOS, free for 20 entries.
